# Enrich Layer

Enrich Layer provides person, company, school, and professional-network data enrichment and lookup APIs.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/enrich-layer/.

## Actions

- **Check Email Type** (read-only): Check whether an email address is disposable and whether it belongs to a free email provider.
- **Enrich Company** (read-only): Return a structured company profile from its LinkedIn company URL.
- **Enrich Person** (read-only): Return a structured person profile from exactly one LinkedIn, Twitter/X, or Facebook profile URL.
- **Find Person By Email** (read-only): Resolve social profile URLs for a person from a personal or work email address.
- **Find Person By Role** (read-only): Return the single person profile URL that most closely matches a role at a named company.
- **Find Social Profiles By Phone** (read-only): Find LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter/X profile URLs associated with one E.164 phone number.
- **Get Credit Balance** (read-only): Return the connected Enrich Layer account's current credit balance without consuming credits.
- **Resolve Company** (read-only): Resolve a LinkedIn company profile URL from a company domain, company name, or both.
- **Resolve Person** (read-only): Return the closest person profile URL from a first name and company name or domain, or null when no match is found.
